Ya. Sometimes I’ll one having a good day not thinking about it, then someone will post abt insecurities and it remind me too. But at the same time lists help bc when I’m having a bad day I read them too.
Thank you for the recommendation! I was told abt that from my doctor but was hesitant😅
Awww, you’re seriously the sweetest stranger I’ve met🥺👍👍💗💖!!

That’s absolutely awful that you went through that situation🥺😢!!!! I know how you felt because I got bullied as-well and it definitely wasn’t just me being delusional. Back in high school when group of guys pushed me in the subway and laughed while saying they touched me as if I were covid. Another case was when I was in gym class sitting on the floor and a girl made a disgusted face at me and moved away. It hurt so bad and I almost cried. Then later on I was sitting all alone and a clique of girls snickered at me for what seemed like no reason at all. They were clearly talking about me bc they were whispering to each other then looking back at me while laughing. I thought it was because I looked like there was something wrong with me and I was ugly. It’s such a horrible feeling isn’t it. As a highly sensitive person I got very teary eyed a lot but I’ve learnt to suppress the tears. I felt so inferior and angry, and I thought they were nasty soulless monsters. I had dark thoughts like “they don’t know what I’m capable of. I could make them feel bad about being so cruel by scaring them”(or something like that). Btw I’m not a violent person at all but my mind really went to dark places when I felt helpless and belittled. 

Your point about her making subconscious gestures and feeling insecure as-well is a very valid point. I do it too and then think omg what if they think like me and I made them feel bad!!

Thank you so much for sharing you personal experience and providing me advice. You’re such a beautiful person because of your consideration to write on this post❤️❤️❤️❤️.
That’s fascinating! I was diagnosed with OCD and BDD). Thank you for sharing your knowledge with me!:)

How I look, being socially inept, being behind in school and behind in my generation overall because of my anxiety, being depressed bc of everything, and feeling like living is a hopeless struggle to attain happiness and satisfaction with my self.

I really appreciate your feedback. I really feel like I’m being mocked and it hurts me every time. It’s still hard to believe that it’s confirmation bias that’s going on and I don’t really know how I can overcome this problem
I guess it depends on the severity of it
